title: Multi-LLM Agentic AI at the Edge: Joint Agent Scheduling and Resource Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2611.20915v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, an edge-enabled multi-large language model (LLM) agentic AI architecture is proposed, where one supervisor AI agent and multiple worker AI agents cooperatively execute users' requests at the edge. The supervisor AI agent decouples the user request into a series of sub-tasks and dynamically dispatches them to LLM-equipped worker AI agents via two agentic workflows, i.e., parallel and serial workflows, with a two-level retry mechanism to enhance execution reliability. To prolong the service duration of worker AI agents, the energy minimization problems are formulated by jointly considering AI agent selection and resource allocation, subject to task execution latency and quality of service (QoS) constraints. A resource allocation scheme based on alternating optimization (AO) is proposed. Specifically, for the parallel workflow, the scheme decouples the original problem into bandwidth allocation, retrieval selection and AI age

translated_title: 边缘环境下的多LLM智能体AI：智能体调度与资源分配联合优化
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种边缘使能的多大语言模型（LLM）智能体AI架构，其中一个监督AI智能体与多个工作AI智能体在边缘端协作执行用户请求。监督AI智能体将用户请求解耦为一系列子任务，并通过两种智能体工作流（即并行和串行工作流）将其动态调度至配备LLM的工作AI智能体，同时采用两级重试机制以增强执行可靠性。为延长工作AI智能体的服务时长，本文在任务执行时延和服务质量（QoS）约束下，联合考虑AI智能体选择与资源分配，构建了能量最小化问题。文章提出了一种基于交替优化（AO）的资源分配方案。具体而言，对于并行工作流，该方案将原始问题解耦为带宽分配、检索选择与AI智能体选择等子问题进行求解。
tldr: 本文提出边缘端多LLM智能体AI架构，通过监督智能体与工作智能体的协作及并行/串行工作流调度，联合优化智能体选择与资源分配以最小化能耗、延长边缘AI智能体的服务时长。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an edge-enabled multi-LLM agentic AI architecture where a supervisor agent collaborates with worker agents via parallel/serial workflows, jointly optimizing agent selection and resource allocation to minimize energy consumption and prolong the service duration of edge AI agents.
